title: HN: "Cerebras discontinue its free tier plan"
summary: Cerebras is sunsetting the current free API tier for a credit-based one on August 17, 2026 (top commenters say they got an email about it); separately, per [a practitioner's account](https://ianlpaterson.com/blog/free-llm-api-2026/) from earlier this year, Cerebras had already quietly pruned its free-tier model catalog from ~a dozen models to two with no notice that reached him, breaking a hardcoded integration with a silent 404; the lesson either way: version and deprecate loudly, since developer trust is what disappears along with the free tier

summary: ships three growth tactics weekly, each with a named real-company example, positioned as "a growth hire, for the price of lunch" — a bet that generic playbooks are now commoditized and personalized, evidenced tactics are the wedge

title: DevRelCon NYC talk teaser: "The Market is Trying to Tell You Something"
summary: a practitioner's 2025 job-search pattern: DevRel postings now screen for specific, measurable ROI skills the listings themselves don't mention

title: GoDaddy launches a Developer Platform built for agents, not just developers
summary: docs ship as markdown/plain-text/OpenAPI and the quickstart's first line tells you to hand `domains-v3.json` to your LLM as context; the purchase flow adds quote-then-execute, idempotency keys, and explicit consent so an agent can't over-buy — a concrete, copyable instance of "treat the agent as a first-class reader"

title: Atlassian repositions Jira as the "orchestration hub" for human+agent dev teams
summary: new Jira Planner, Coding Agent, and an Agentic Engineering Template target coordination overhead, not code-gen speed; Atlassian's own DevAI lead frames the pitch as "bring the true value rather than boosting usage itself" — a notable positioning pivot for a tool developers have long resented

title: Common Room: the 5 usage-based plays Otter.ai used to 2x outbound pipeline
summary: first-party product-usage data (meeting count/minutes, 7-day new-user adds, in-app engagement, weighted roughly 80% behavior / 20-30% firmographics) beats commoditized intent data; Otter caps itself at 10-12 total plays to keep it simple

title: Zoom to acquire Common Room
summary: announced 2026-07-02, surfaced today via a 2026-07-16 Draft.dev technical breakdown for GTM teams; Common Room (used by Atlassian, Anthropic, Notion, Snowflake for community/product-signal intelligence) folds into Zoom's AI revenue stack — third GTM-intelligence consolidation in about eight months, after Clari+Salesloft (Dec 2025) and Apollo+Pocus (Mar 2026)
